title: Step-by-Step and Competitive Assembly of Two Dy(III) Single-Molecule Magnets with Their Performance Tuned by Schiff Base Ligands

material_class.structural_family: dinuclear nine-coordinate Dy(III) Schiff-base cluster; muffin geometry; supramolecular 14-connected fcu net via weak interactions

synthesis.procedure: Dy2: 0.1 mmol HLa (1-methyl-1H-benzo[d]imidazole-2-carbaldehyde), 0.1 mmol HLb (1-aminonaphthalen-2-ol) and 0.5 mmol Dy(OAc)3·6H2O were weighed; 0.75 mL methanol and 0.75 mL acetonitrile were stirred and sealed in an 18 cm Pyrex tube. Three drops of triethylammonium were added. The mixture was heated at 80 °C for 24 h, taken out, and slowly cooled to room temperature to give red crystals. Yield 86% based on Dy(OAc)3·6H2O. In situ Schiff-base ligand HL1 forms from HLa and HLb. The isolated formula from elemental analysis is [Dy2(L1)2(NO3)2(OAc)2(CH3OH)2].

properties.summary: Dinuclear Dy2 is a zero-field single-molecule magnet. Room-temperature χmT is slightly below the free-ion value, falls sharply below about 50 K, and magnetization does not saturate as expected for two free Dy(III) ions; M vs H/T curves do not superimpose, indicating anisotropy. An S-shaped hysteresis loop is reported. The out-of-phase ac susceptibility is frequency dependent at zero dc field and fits a single Debye process with a narrow α range and an Orbach barrier lower than many Dy SMMs but higher than that of Dy4.

material_class.structural_family: mixed-ligand tetranuclear vacant/defective cubane Dy(III) cluster; eight-coordinate biaugmented trigonal prism or triangular dodecahedron; supramolecular 6-connected ftw net

synthesis.procedure: Dy4: 0.15 mmol HLb (1-aminonaphthalen-2-ol), 0.15 mmol HLc (2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzaldehyde) and 0.1 mmol DyCl3·6H2O were weighed and sealed with 3 mL methanol in an 18 cm Pyrex tube and stirred. Three drops of pyridin-2-ylmethanamine (HLd) were added. The mixture was heated at 80 °C for three days, taken out, and slowly cooled to room temperature to give red crystals. Yield 71% based on DyCl3·6H2O. Two in situ Schiff bases form competitively: H2L2 (1-((2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzylidene)amino)naphthalen-2-ol) and HL3 (2-methoxy-6-(((pyridin-2-ylmethyl)imino)methyl)phenol). Elemental analysis formula [Dy4(L2)2(L3)2(OH)2(Cl)4]; crystal formula includes lattice water equivalent to C64H54Cl4Dy4N6O14.

properties.summary: Tetranuclear Dy4 is a zero-field SMM with a lower effective barrier and a broader relaxation-time distribution than Dy2. χmT at room temperature is slightly below the value expected for four Dy(III) ions and drops to 18.90 cm^3 K mol^-1 at 2 K. Magnetization reaches 20.92 Nβ at 2 K and 5 T, M vs H/T curves do not superimpose, and an S-shaped hysteresis loop is reported. Ac data at zero dc field follow a single Debye model.
